equations.tex: \mathbb E I=0,\qquad \mathbb E I^2=\mathbb E\sum_i H_i^2h_i.
\begin{aligned}\mathbb E X_t&=m+(m_0-m)e^{-\theta t},\\v(t)&=v_0e^{-2\theta t}+\frac{\eta^2}{2\theta}(1-e^{-2\theta t}),\\v'(t)&=\eta^2-2\theta v(t).\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}c&=\operatorname{Cov}(\Delta W,J)=\frac{1-e^{-\theta h}}{\theta},\\v_J&=\frac{1-e^{-2\theta h}}{2\theta},\\J&=\frac c h\Delta W+\sqrt{v_J-c^2/h}\,Z_2,\\&\hspace{2em}Z_2\perp\Delta W.\end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}\mathbb E Y_n&=(1+d)^n,\\\mathbb E X_T&=e^{\mu T},\\\mathbb E Y_n^2&=((1+d)^2+r)^n,\\\mathbb E X_T^2&=e^{(2\mu+\sigma^2)T},\\\mathbb E[X_TY_n]&=e^{\mu T}(1+d+r)^n.\end{aligned}

independentFindingsBeforeFreeze.finding: The QV paragraph and changed-increment answer called the refinement random.
independentFindingsBeforeFreeze.resolution: Both now explicitly say random Brownian increments observed along deterministic partition refinements; the existing mesh/dyadic proof is retained.

independentFindingsBeforeFreeze.finding: The GBM quantile uses sigma rather than its absolute value.
independentFindingsBeforeFreeze.resolution: The body now declares nonnegative volatility before the formulas and explains the absolute-value scale for a negative written scalar diffusion coefficient.

readingRefinements: Long equations broken into readable aligned steps without shrinking type.
Simple analytic distributions/error curves, one-step stress plot and curvature figure fit mobile; dense paths retain announced keyboard scrolling.
Long native-select captions shortened without removing the nearby Gaussian/atom explanations.
Compact labels use20.5 source pixels and a larger left axis margin; the final interaction and fresh reading checks verify all three widths and every compact label at the frozen size.
limits: Finite bounded teaching models, not arbitrary-range arithmetic.
Selector values and representative boundary/interior time cursors checked; no claim to exhaust every seed or continuous input.
Seeded paths, analytic laws and schematic geometry are explicitly distinguished.
No screen-reader speech pass or untested-browser certification.
The official video page/identity and companion notes were checked; no full-video watch claim.
No author-owned shared registry, catalogue, global stylesheet, build or ledger mutation.

stressControlAmendment.finding: Disabled seeded controls could display stale resolution/noise while the stress fixture used one step and sigma1.
stressControlAmendment.resolution: Rendered disabled values are forced to the actual one-step and sigma1 settings; returning to seeded mode restores its remembered controls.
stressControlAmendment.scope: Two rendered-value expressions and one option list; algorithm/model/body/example/CSS/brief bytes unchanged. Full interaction matrix is prior evidence; this focused actual-browser check covers the final state-control amendment.

findings.claim: random partition/refinement wording after a deterministic-partition proof
findings.resolution: Both theory and practice now distinguish random increments from deterministic refinements.

findings.claim: Unsigned sigma used in GBM quantile without an explicit nonnegative convention
findings.resolution: Nonnegative volatility is explicit; a negative written coefficient requires absolute sigma for the quantile.

findings.claim: Disabled seeded controls contradict active one-step stress fixture
findings.resolution: Active one-step and sigma1 now display correctly; seeded values are restored on return.

attribution: Independent full source/proof/native review and 14 actually opened final screenshots. Author owns broad browser/keyboard sweeps and the focused corrective browser run; reviewer read and matched their final evidence. No deployment/user-study/full-video claim.
